name: Affilibee for WooCommerce
author: Affilibee

sections.description:
Affilibee for WooCommerce is the easiest way to start an affiliate program for your store. It connects WooCommerce with Affilibee, the e-commerce-first affiliate marketing platform.

Affilibee is designed for merchants who want results without unnecessary overhead. With this plugin, you can set up your affiliate program quickly, invite affiliates, track sales, and automate payouts, all from a lightweight, GDPR-ready system that’s free until you reach $1,000 in affiliate-driven revenue.

Why choose Affilibee for WooCommerce?

  • 🚀 Fast setup – Install the plugin, connect your Affilibee account, and start tracking within 30 minutes.
  • 🛒 Built for e-commerce – Optimized for WooCommerce with support for product-based commissions.
  • 💸 Automatic payouts – Pay affiliates automatically via PayPal, no spreadsheets or manual transfers.
  • 📊 Affiliate dashboard – Give affiliates their own links and performance insights.
  • 🔒 Privacy-first – GDPR-ready tracking that avoids intrusive cookie banners.
  • 💡 Free to start – Get going with no cost. Affilibee is free until you hit $1,000 in affiliate sales.

Affilibee is a clear, user-friendly way to turn your affiliates, customers, and influencers into a reliable sales channel.

External services

This plugin connects to Affilibee to record affiliate-attributed orders and calculate commissions. When an order is marked Completed in WooCommerce and linked to an affiliate, the plugin submits the order details needed to track the sale and commission.

No customer personal data (such as name, email, address, or phone number) is ever sent. Only non-identifiable order and product information is transmitted to the Affilibee API at affilibee.com. For details, see the Affilibee Terms of Service and Privacy Policy.
sections.installation:
1. Register for a free merchant account at affilibee.com/merchant/register.
  2. Upload the plugin files to /wp-content/plugins/affilibee-for-woocommerce/ or install directly from the WordPress plugin directory.
  3. In WooCommerce → Settings → Affilibee, enter your Affilibee API token (and test token if you want to test).
  4. Save changes. Done! Orders completed in WooCommerce with affiliate attribution will now sync to Affilibee.
sections.faq:
What is Affilibee?

Affilibee is an affiliate marketing platform built specifically for e-commerce. It makes it easy to launch an affiliate program, track sales, and handle payouts with minimal effort.

How are affiliate sales tracked?

When a customer visits your store with an affiliate link or coupon code, the plugin stores the attribution using first-party cookies. Once the order is marked Completed in WooCommerce, it is reported to Affilibee for commission calculation.

How are payouts handled?

Commissions first enter a pending phase to account for refunds. They are then confirmed and paid out automatically via PayPal on the 14th of the following month.

Does Affilibee support multiple currencies?

Yes. Affilibee supports multi-currency stores. While not all WooCommerce currency plugins have been tested, most work without issues. If you encounter any problems, our support team is always happy to help.

Is it GDPR compliant?

Yes. Affilibee uses first-party cookies and privacy-first tracking methods that are GDPR-ready. This keeps you compliant without requiring intrusive cookie banners.

Is the plugin HPOS compatible?

Yes. Affilibee for WooCommerce is fully compatible with WooCommerce High-Performance Order Storage (HPOS).

Will the plugin slow down my site?

No. The plugin is very lightweight and built to modern WordPress and WooCommerce standards. It won’t affect your site’s performance or SEO.

How much does it cost?

Affilibee is free until you generate $1,000/month in affiliate sales. Paid plans scale as your store grows. You can view all pricing options at affilibee.com.

Where do I create my API token?

Log in to your Affilibee merchant dashboard and navigate to Integrations → Affilibee API.
